zh-CN.title: 图片预览与日历优化
items: Chronelle 授权页使用 Frienden 友间新名称及图标，用途说明跟随用户语言设置
时序日历支持直接跳转授权并自动绑定，无需粘贴链接；恢复应用和插件卡片底色
优化时序插件图标展示，去除灰色外框，使用完整圆角图标
菜单新增应用和插件分类，基础信息支持以好友或陌生人视角预览我的名片
图片预览去除画布底色、边框与阴影，仅保留全局米色背景

en.title: Image preview and calendar improvements
items: Chronelle authorization uses the Frienden 友间 name and icon, with a concise purpose in your preferred language
Authorize on Chronelle and bind automatically without pasting links; restored app and plugin card backgrounds
Chronelle's rounded icon now fills its tile without a gray frame
Browse apps and plugins in separate tabs and preview your profile card from a friend or stranger perspective
Image previews now use a single beige backdrop without a separate canvas background, border or shadow
